evidence_class: Static: frozen expected-red C2-C4 control-design review; no Rust, Python, candidate, physical, or target execution by reviewer

findings.finding: Each candidate helper receives both the retained capture and the complete expected case JSON. A helper can copy p1, Dot2 residuals, p2, the assessment, or canned eligibility values, so the controls do not discriminate a numerical implementation.
findings.required_fix: Keep expected JSON assertion-side. Pass only raw retained operands and typed configuration into a thin test adapter that invokes the actual shared refinement/controller seam.

findings.finding: The retained-face control checks p1, residuals, p2, a zero added-factorization counter, and an entire assessment value. It omits p0, both correction vectors, active-coordinate preservation, actual factor reuse/application evidence, h/Cbar/tau/classification operands, and explicit final box/radius feasibility. The assessment also contains offline exact-reference fields that the runtime does not own.
findings.required_fix: Assert the retained p0 and active mask/value bits, delta0, p1, all Dot2 residual bits, delta1, p2, shared factor identity/application counts with no refactorization, runtime h/Cbar/tau/classes, explicit feasibility, and the unchanged BVLS-02 decision. Do not require runtime production of offline exact-reference diagnostics.

findings.finding: Summary counters and a live_state_unchanged boolean do not establish scratch custody. There are no hook argument logs or state snapshots and no real negative final-feasibility, radius, or active-value inputs exercising typed refusal.
findings.required_fix: Observe the actual shared seam: prove the retained p1 box violation, Dot2-only scratch consumption, empty hook argument logs, exact hook counters, bit-identical before/after state, and concrete final-box, radius, and active-mutation cases that return the exact typed refusal with no step, publication, or fallback.

findings.finding: One aggregate helper returns eligibility and budget booleans for every case. The control supplies no distinct raw operands or observable actions, work counts, or budget states, so a fixture factory satisfies it.
findings.required_fix: Drive separate concrete cases through the actual decision seam for positive and negative zero eligibility, nonzero lambda, radius-active, initially box-infeasible, and refinement refusal. Assert unchanged BVLS-02 outputs for ineligible cases, exactly two corrections for eligible cases, no fallback or third correction, exact denied attempted work before entry, and before/after nested budget custody.

residual_risk: A test-only adapter may parse retained JSON, but numerical decisions, factor application, guards, work accounting, state custody, and BVLS-02 continuation must be exercised by the same shared implementation used by the controller; a parallel test algorithm would preserve the fixture-factory risk.
missing_evidence: A corrected, immutable expected-red controls freeze
Parent-owned compile receipt for that exact corrected freeze
Subsequent body review and green receipt; neither is implied by expected-red approval
workspace_boundary: The live source changed after controls01 was frozen. Those later unpinned edits were intentionally excluded from this disposition and require a new exact freeze.
